thought.text: All config files present. Now create webapp.properties (Dienste-Tomcat webapp↔workspace links) and deploy WARs to the three Tomcat instances:

reasoning_content:
All the required property files are present: managerConfiguration.properties, managerWebConfiguration.properties, validatorConfiguration.properties.

Next, I'll create a webapp.properties for the Dienste-Tomcat at DEEGREE_WORKSPACE_ROOT, and copy the WARs to the Tomcat webapps directory.

action.command:
cat > /opt/deegree/webapp.properties <<'EOF'
/xplan-services-wms=xplan-services-wms-workspace
/xplan-services-wfs-syn=xplan-services-wfs-syn-workspace
/xplan-services-wfs=xplan-services-wfs-workspace
/xplan-webservices-validator-wms=xplan-webservices-validator-wms-memory-workspace
/xplan-webservices-inspireplu=xplan-webservices-inspireplu-workspace
EOF
cp /tmp/dist/web/xplan-services-wfs.war /tmp/dist/web/xplan-services-wfs-syn.war /tmp/dist/web/xplan-services-wms.war /tmp/dist/web/xplan-webservices-validator-wms.war /tmp/dist/web/xplan-webservices-inspireplu.war /opt/tomcat-dienste/webapps/
cp /tmp/dist/web/xplan-manager-web.war /tmp/dist/web/xplan-validator-web.war /tmp/dist/web/xplan-webpages.war /opt/tomcat-anwendung/webapps/
cp /tmp/dist/web/xplan-manager-api.war /tmp/dist/web/xplan-validator-api.war /tmp/dist/web/xplan-dokumente-api.war /opt/tomcat-api/webapps/
ls /opt/tomcat-dienste/webapps /opt/tomcat-anwendung/webapps /opt/tomcat-api/webapps

summary: Create webapp.properties, deploy WARs to Tomcats
